title: 真实Zabbix恢复迟滞：修正获批下限，验证两个自动问题与恢复周期
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 既有ID升级真实服务端判分证据，不重复增加题量。
rubric: 已知问题表达式last(temp)>80已为false，恢复表达式last(temp)<-50始终false，监控项持续有新值。
配置恢复表达式时，需要问题表达式为false且恢复表达式为true才能恢复；错误恢复门槛导致事件滞留。
经业务确认改为合理迟滞阈值，例如低于70，并核对事件实际恢复、恢复动作与工单状态；不要仅手动关事件掩盖错误配置。

conversion.original_title: 温度告警已经降到正常值仍不恢复，恢复条件误写为负温且现场不可能达到，如何处理？

body:
## 操作任务
实现plan_temperature_recovery(trigger,host,key,problem_high,recover_below)。仅处理独立trigger.get对象、recovery_mode=1、精确expression=last(/host/key)>problem_high，现恢复表达式只允许同operand加<有符号整数；不支持其他表达式或宏。host仅[A-Za-z0-9_. 空格-]、key仅[A-Za-z0-9_.]；阈值须为非bool整数且recover_below<problem_high。输出仅triggerid、recovery_mode=1、recovery_expression=last(/host/key)<recover_below；不修改expression、依赖、标签或输入对象。继承/发现对象、非法ID、其他表达式及非批准门槛拒绝。 实际服务端先产生90度问题，降到75仍未恢复；应用批准恢复阈值后75/70仍保持问题，69.5才恢复，另一个问题周期可由负温恢复；原问题表达式始终保持。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py真实服务端链路验证。

## 能力边界
真实Zabbix7.0.32服务端/官方库结构与私有PostgreSQL15.19，实际TCP收样、history与事件/源IP边界；学习者返回最小更新计划，判分器仅在私有库应用批准字段。未运行PHP前端/JSON-RPC API，不部署或改宿主默认身份；既有题目证据升级，新增题目计数为零。

import os,sys,pathlib,copy,time,re,ipaddress,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from zabbix_server_fixture import PrivateServer
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with PrivateServer() as server:
 db=server.db
 db.execute("INSERT INTO hosts(hostid,host,name,status) VALUES(1000000,'training-node','Private training node',0); INSERT INTO items(itemid,hostid,type,name,key_,value_type,history,trends,units) VALUES(1000001,1000000,2,'Temperature','temp',0,'1d','0','C'); INSERT INTO item_rtdata(itemid) VALUES(1000001); INSERT INTO triggers(triggerid,expression,recovery_mode,recovery_expression,description,priority) VALUES(1000002,'{1000003}>80',1,'{1000003}<-50','Private temperature hysteresis',2); INSERT INTO functions(functionid,itemid,triggerid,name,parameter) VALUES(1000003,1000001,1000002,'last','$')")
 server.start()
 def sample(value,expected_state):
  stamp,ack=server.send(value,key='temp');assert ack['response']=='success'
  server.wait(lambda:db.execute('select value from history where itemid=1000001 and clock='+str(stamp//1000000000)+' and ns='+str(stamp%1000000000)),'actual temperature history committed')
  server.wait(lambda:db.execute('select value from triggers where triggerid=1000002')==[[str(expected_state)]],'actual expected trigger state committed')
  stable_until=time.monotonic()+1
  while time.monotonic()<stable_until:
   assert db.execute('select value from triggers where triggerid=1000002')==[[str(expected_state)]],'actual problem/recovery state failed bounded stability observation'
   time.sleep(.04)
 sample(90,1);sample(75,1)
 assert db.execute('select value from events where objectid=1000002 and source=0 and object=0 order by eventid')==[['1']],'old recovery threshold must leave actual problem unresolved'
 print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_HYSTERESIS_PROBLEM_REMAINS_AFTER_TEMPERATURE_FALLS_WITH_UNREACHABLE_RECOVERY',flush=True)
 obj=dict(triggerid='1000002',expression='last(/training-node/temp)>80',recovery_mode='1',recovery_expression='last(/training-node/temp)<-50',templateid='0',flags='0');before=copy.deepcopy(obj)
 original_problem=db.execute('select expression,description,priority from triggers where triggerid=1000002');original_item=db.execute('select key_,value_type,units,history,trends from items where itemid=1000001')
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:plan_temperature_recovery_real_events',flush=True)
 patch=task.plan_temperature_recovery(obj,'training-node','temp',80,70)
 assert set(patch)=={'triggerid','recovery_mode','recovery_expression'} and patch['triggerid']=='1000002' and patch['recovery_mode']==1 and obj==before,'unapproved problem threshold or other fields changed'
 match=re.fullmatch(r'last\(/training-node/temp\)([<>])(-?[0-9]+)',patch['recovery_expression']);assert match,'only approved single-function comparison syntax supported'
 expression='{1000003}'+match[1]+match[2]
 db.execute("update triggers set recovery_mode=1,recovery_expression='"+expression+"' where triggerid=1000002");server.reload()
 for value,state in ((75,1),(70,1),(69.5,0),(90,1),(75,1),(-3.5,0)):sample(value,state)
 assert db.execute('select value from events where objectid=1000002 and source=0 and object=0 order by eventid')==[['1'],['0'],['1'],['0']],'must observe two real problem/recovery cycles without manual event closure'
 assert db.execute('select expression,description,priority from triggers where triggerid=1000002')==original_problem and db.execute('select key_,value_type,units,history,trends from items where itemid=1000001')==original_item
 for changed in ({**obj,'expression':'last(/other/temp)>80'},{**obj,'recovery_mode':'0'},{**obj,'templateid':'22'},{**obj,'flags':'4'},{**obj,'recovery_expression':'last(/training-node/temp)<-50 or 1=1'}):
  try:task.plan_temperature_recovery(changed,'training-node','temp',80,70)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('unsupported trigger ownership or expression accepted')
 print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_REAL_HYSTERESIS_STRICT_70_BOUNDARY_AND_TWO_AUTOMATIC_PROBLEM_RECOVERY_CYCLES_KEEP_PROBLEM_EXPRESSION',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

title: 真实Zabbix trapper新出口：叠加批准源IP，旧许可与其他item边界保持
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 既有ID升级真实服务端判分证据，不重复增加题量。
rubric: 技术主机名、item键和trapper类型均正确，服务端看到的是新NAT出口地址，而Allowed hosts仍只允许旧出口。
根因是item接收来源白名单不匹配。
确认网络真实出口与身份后最小化更新允许列表，等待配置缓存同步，再验证processed与failed计数和实际最新值；不要用全网放开代替来源治理。

conversion.original_title: sender迁到新出口后连接成功但所有值被拒绝，服务端记录来源不允许，怎样修复？

body:
## 操作任务
实现plan_trapper_source(item,evidence)，只处理独立type=2的trapper item；题目将技术主机名扁平放在technical_host。evidence必须同技术主机名和key_、processed=0/failed=1/error_code=source_not_allowed，observed_source_ip为服务端所见IP字面量，不用sender_private_ip替代。trapper_hosts仅支持逗号分隔IP/CIDR，旧非空字符串和各条许可原样保留，若新IP不在现有网段内，仅尾部追加规范IP并生成最小itemid/trapper_hosts更新；不清空或替换旧许可。已覆盖时update=None并转查配置缓存；空名单本已允许所有来源，和拒绝证据矛盾，须拒绝。未解析主机名/宏/范围或错误类型/身份/继承对象ValueError。返回diagnosis提示缓存同步、processed计数和最新值仍需复验，existing_access_preserved=True；不发送请求。 实际私有loopback的127.0.0.1/127.0.0.3分别模拟旧出口和新出口，均由真实TCP源地址决定，不采用sender_private_ip；补齐后旧新来源均有history，127.0.0.4及其他item仍拒绝。

## 提交产物

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py真实服务端链路验证。

import os,sys,pathlib,copy,time,re,ipaddress,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from zabbix_server_fixture import PrivateServer
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with PrivateServer() as server:
 db=server.db
 db.execute("INSERT INTO hosts(hostid,host,name,status) VALUES(1000000,'training-node','Private training node',0); INSERT INTO items(itemid,hostid,type,name,key_,value_type,history,trends,trapper_hosts) VALUES(1000001,1000000,2,'Approved NAT sender','sender.value',3,'1d','0','127.0.0.1'),(1000011,1000000,2,'Protected sender','protected.counter',3,'1d','0','127.0.0.1'); INSERT INTO item_rtdata(itemid) VALUES(1000001),(1000011)")
 server.start()
 def accepted(value,source,key='sender.value',itemid=1000001):
  stamp,result=server.send(value,key=key,source=source);assert result['response']=='success' and re.search(r'processed: 1; failed: 0;',result['info']),result
  server.wait(lambda:db.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid='+str(itemid)+' and clock='+str(stamp//1000000000)+' and ns='+str(stamp%1000000000))==[[str(value)]],'actual authorized sender history persisted')
 def denied(source,key='sender.value',itemid=1000001):
  stamp,result=server.send(99,key=key,source=source);assert result['response']=='success' and re.search(r'processed: 0; failed: 1;',result['info']),result
  assert db.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid='+str(itemid)+' and clock='+str(stamp//1000000000)+' and ns='+str(stamp%1000000000))==[]
  return result
 accepted(7,'127.0.0.1');failure=denied('127.0.0.3')
 print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_TRAPPER_OLD_SOURCE_ALLOWED_NEW_TRANSPORT_SOURCE_ACTUALLY_REJECTED',flush=True)
 item=dict(itemid='1000001',type='2',technical_host='training-node',key_='sender.value',trapper_hosts='127.0.0.1',templateid='0',flags='0');before=copy.deepcopy(item)
 evidence=dict(technical_host='training-node',key_='sender.value',processed=0,failed=1,error_code='source_not_allowed',observed_source_ip='127.0.0.3',sender_private_ip='192.0.2.77');protected=db.execute('select itemid,trapper_hosts,key_,value_type,history,trends from items where itemid=1000011');config_hash=hashlib.sha256(server.config.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:plan_trapper_source_real_transport_identity',flush=True)
 plan=task.plan_trapper_source(item,evidence);assert set(plan)=={'update','diagnosis','existing_access_preserved'} and plan['existing_access_preserved'] is True and item==before
 patch=plan['update'];assert set(patch)=={'itemid','trapper_hosts'} and patch['itemid']=='1000001' and isinstance(patch['trapper_hosts'],str)
 allowed=patch['trapper_hosts'];networks=[ipaddress.ip_network(part.strip(),strict=False) for part in allowed.split(',')];assert networks and all(net.version==4 for net in networks)
 assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9.,/ ]+',allowed),'only explicit reviewed IP/CIDR literals may enter private fixture update'
 db.execute("update items set trapper_hosts='"+allowed+"' where itemid=1000001");server.reload()
 accepted(9,'127.0.0.3');accepted(11,'127.0.0.1');denied('127.0.0.4');denied('127.0.0.3',key='protected.counter',itemid=1000011);accepted(13,'127.0.0.1',key='protected.counter',itemid=1000011)
 assert db.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid=1000001 order by value')==[['7'],['9'],['11']] and protected==db.execute('select itemid,trapper_hosts,key_,value_type,history,trends from items where itemid=1000011')
 assert hashlib.sha256(server.config.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==config_hash and plan['diagnosis']=='append_observed_nat_source_then_verify_cached_config_and_processed_values'
 assert allowed=='127.0.0.1,127.0.0.3','existing literal grant must be retained exactly with only approved source appended'
 assert task.plan_trapper_source({**item,'trapper_hosts':allowed},evidence)==dict(update=None,diagnosis='source_already_allowed_review_cached_config',existing_access_preserved=True)
 for changed in ({**item,'trapper_hosts':''},{**item,'type':'0'},{**item,'templateid':'22'},{**item,'trapper_hosts':'{$UNREVIEWED}'},{**item,'flags':'4'}):
  try:task.plan_trapper_source(changed,evidence)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('unapproved or contradictory sender evidence accepted')
 print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_TRAPPER_ACTUAL_NEW_OLD_SOURCES_PASS_UNAPPROVED_OTHER_ITEM_DENIED_HISTORY_PRESERVED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
